Direct.description: Published by the peer the notice arrived from.

Relayed.description: Relayed: the publisher is a different peer from the one it arrived from.

OwnNode.description: Published by the receiving node itself.

Unattributed.description: The publisher could not be established.

PeerIdentifier.description: The key embedded in the publisher's peer identifier.

OperatorTrust.description: A key the operator configured as trusted.

SelfAsserted.description: A key carried in the notice itself (proves integrity, not identity).

PNVEntry.description: One received notice and the verdict on it.

PNM_CID.description: Content identifier of the $PNM the verdict is about.

PUBLISHER_PEER_ID.description: Peer that signed and published the notice.

RECEIVED_FROM_PEER_ID.description: Peer the notice arrived from (gossip or direct).

STANDARD.description: Standard the publication is in, as its code, e.g. "OMM".

SCHEMA_NAME.description: Schema file name of the published records, e.g. "OMM.fbs".

FILE_ID.description: The notice's FILE_ID (publication or update identity).

CID.description: The notice's CID (the published content or its manifest).

PUBLISHED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds of publication, from the notice.

RECEIVED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds the receiving node received the notice.

SIGNATURE_TYPE.description:
Signature scheme of the notice, verbatim from the $PNM, e.g. "Ed25519",
"Secp256k1". The signature is over the notice's signed bytes, hashed
once: Ed25519 signs the bytes themselves; Secp256k1 is a DER ECDSA
signature over ONE SHA-256 of the bytes (the libp2p secp256k1 key form).
A signature over SHA-256(SHA-256(bytes)) does not verify.

SIGNATURE_VERIFIED.description: True when the signature verified against PUBLISHER_KEY.

Direct.description: Published by the peer the notice arrived from.

Relayed.description: Relayed: the publisher is a different peer from the one it arrived from.

OwnNode.description: Published by the receiving node itself.

Unattributed.description: The publisher could not be established.

PUBLISHER_KEY.description: The public key the signature was checked against.

PeerIdentifier.description: The key embedded in the publisher's peer identifier.

OperatorTrust.description: A key the operator configured as trusted.

SelfAsserted.description: A key carried in the notice itself (proves integrity, not identity).

REASON.description: Why verification failed or was not attempted; empty when it verified.

PNM_BYTES.description:
The notice itself as received, a size-prefixed $PNM, so a reader can
verify the signature on its own instead of trusting this verdict.

PNV.description: Publication Verification - one node's verdicts on received notices.

VERIFIER_PEER_ID.description: Identifier of the node that verified.

GENERATED_AT_MS.description: Unix milliseconds when this set was generated.

ETAG.description: Entity tag of this set, for conditional requests.
